meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI-powered video and image generation software (text-to-video, image-to-video, generative creative tools)

analysis.summary: Runway is pushing hard on model pages and AI-chat integrations. Pika copies the integration move and adds prompt guides, while HeyGen goes deep on industries and avatars.

points.text: Runway updated 23 old pages, mostly model landing pages, which signals a refresh push as new models like Kling 4.0 and Seedance 2.5 arrive.
Runway, Pika and Luma all published pages on working inside ChatGPT or Claude, so AI-chat distribution is now a standard move.
Pika wrote 11 new how-to pages, mostly prompt guides for each model. Runway has one prompt pack and a few guides.

Runway.play: Hosts every major model, plugs into ChatGPT, Claude and editing tools, and launches ads and app-building products.

Pika.play: Prompt guides for each new model, a ChatGPT integration, and its own H3 Flex fast-video model.
Pika.aimed: Creators learning to prompt AI video

Luma AI.play: Small output: a Claude and ChatGPT connection guide, a learning hub, and one research paper.

Kling AI.play: No pages found on the site in this data, so no content play can be read.

HeyGen.play: Industry landing pages, avatar and voice products, case studies, translation guides, and a developer API.

shared.title: AI-chat integrations
shared.text: Runway has pages for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot and MCP. Pika and Luma have ChatGPT and Claude pages. Runway has the widest set, so keep it fresh and easy to find.

shared.title: Third-party model hubs
shared.text: Runway lists many partner models. Pika covers Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0 and Kling 4.0. HeyGen has a 'Top AI Video Model' page. Pages compete to be the place to try new models.

shared.title: Research and technical posts
shared.text: Runway, Luma and HeyGen each posted research on speed, efficiency or benchmarks. Pika added a technical deep dive. It signals technical credibility with developers.

gaps.title: Model comparison pages
gaps.text: Only one comparing page each at Pika and few at others. Runway hosts many models, so it could own honest side-by-side guides for filmmakers.

gaps.title: Per-model prompt guides
gaps.text: Pika has about 5 distinct guides. Runway has one prompt pack and no per-model series, so it could cover its hosted models in depth.

gaps.title: Filmmaker case studies
gaps.text: HeyGen has 4 case studies. Runway's data shows no customer stories, so it could own real film and production workflows.

versus.Pika: Pika focuses on prompt guides and learning content, while Runway focuses on buying-stage landing pages and product launches.
versus.Luma AI: Luma publishes very little, with 3 new pages, while Runway publishes 25 new pages and many updates.
versus.Kling AI: No pages were found for Kling AI, so there is nothing to compare, though Runway and Pika both promote Kling 4.0.
versus.HeyGen: HeyGen targets business users with industry pages and case studies, while Runway targets creators and marketers with model pages and integrations.
